intent: A player whose bomb chain reaches 3 or more earns a 1.5x score multiplier for 10 seconds, shown to everyone as a glowing ring around that player; a later short chain or the timeout ends it.
accept: Finishing a chain of 3+ bombs gives that player a 1.5x score multiplier on knockouts for 10 seconds
A glowing ring is visible around the multiplier holder while it is active
The multiplier ends after 10 seconds or when the player's next chain is shorter than 3
Tests show a knockout scoring 1.5x during the multiplier and 1x after it ends
